I love this game with every fiber of my body and will always come back from time to time to climb a random mountain and watch over a world of art that seems to be drawn with a devine touch to just draw a deep breath and admire the view.

This is my first Souls like game that I have ever played & completed besides the less than an hour I tried playing of Dark Souls a long time ago. The game is a masterpiece & one that is easily in my all time list. The scenery is gorgeous & the boss fights are fun & memorable. I have done 2 playthroughs to try out different classes & I plan to do more because of how much I love this game. I try to tell everyone to play this even if you aren't a Dark Souls player or fan. I like it also because you can make & play the game how you want with it being open world. So if you want to play at the absolute hardest you can by not leveling up, if you want to make the game easier for yourself you can easily level up to do so. The DLC is also fantastic & the boss fight with Messmer was so much fun. I highly recommend everyone to play this at least once in your life.

A masterpiece and one of the best action RPGs ever made

Elden Ring is an incredible game that offers an unforgettable adventure. The world is massive, beautiful and full of secrets, with countless places to explore, hidden bosses to discover and weapons to experiment with.

One of its biggest strengths is the freedom it gives you. The build variety is fantastic, and experimenting with different weapons, spells and playstyles makes every run feel unique. The boss fights, lore and atmosphere are also outstanding, and the sense of discovery when you stumble upon something completely unexpected is hard to beat.

My only real criticism is that the open world can sometimes feel too big and exhausting. After a while, exploring every corner starts to feel more like a checklist than an adventure. And while the PvE experience is exceptional, the invasions and PvP never really clicked with me as much as I hoped.

Still, I completed 100% and absolutely loved the journey. Despite a few flaws, Elden Ring is a monumental achievement and a game every action RPG fan should experience.

An unforgettable adventure, with incredible build variety and one of the best worlds in gaming. A masterpiece.
